verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an accounting system that positions itself as a QuickBooks replacement, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented way to export Books data in open formats. The QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero syncs feed Mercury banking data into other ledgers, which is an adjacent feature rather than an export of Books data. The accounting API is only promised for the future, and P&L, cash flow and balance sheet report generation says nothing about export format.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
